tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// rnal 'byor gsum gyi snying po gsal ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

"$ ༄༅// rgya gar skad du/ tri dzhe ki hri bha bhya ka ra na ma/ bod skad du/ rnal 'byor gsum gyi snying po gsal ba zhes bya ba/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// oṃ gyis snang ba lam du nges// rdo rje sems la phyag 'tshal nas// sbyangs pa rab tu gyur pa'i lam// phyag rgya chen po'i bsgrub pa bshad// dbang gis smin byas dam tshig ldan// de la rnal 'byor gsum bstan te// gzhan la nam yang ma yin no// byin gyis brlabs la rtogs pa bsgom// rang bzhin rnal 'byor gsum du nges// 'chi ba'i rtags nyid shes byas nas// srog ni thig ler nges par bzhug /so sor bsdud dang bsam gtan dang*// srog rtsol de bzhin 'dzin pa dang*// rjes su dran dang ting nge 'dzin// sbyor ba yan lag drug ces bya// mtshan mo gseng med khyim du ni// shin du mnyam bzhag bsgrub pa pos// byed pa lnga la bcing ba gnyis// bla ma'i zhal la shes par bya// yod dang med pa las 'das pa// du ba smig rgyu srin mi khyer// mar me sems kyi nam mkhar mthong*// gzhon nu ma yi pra las ni// lkog tu gyur pa'i rkun ma mthong*// nyi tshe ba'i mig gis ni// bsgrub pa po'i sems gnas mthong*// chu 'dzin dang ni bral ba yi// nam mkha' dwangs par gyur pa la// snga dro nyi ma rgyab phyogs te// phyi dro yang ni de bzhin no// nyin phyed mig la gnod phyir yang*// nam mkha' las byung rang byung ba// shes rab ye shes me bo che// 'od chen rnam par snang bar byed// ye shes skar ma lham me ba// 'gro ba'i mar me ye shes sgron// gzi brjid chen po 'od gsal ba// sngags mchog sngags bdag rigs sngags rgyal// gsang sngags rgyal po don chen byed// ji srid thig le'i nang du ni// ri mo nag po skra yi tshad// de mthong 'od gsal go 'phang ni// rnal 'byor pa yis mthong bar 'gyur// so sor sdud pa snyoms 'jug pa'i// sngags rnams thams cad byin gyis brlab// shes par rtog dang dpyod pa dang*// dga' dang bde ba mi g.yo ba// bsam gtan yan lag lngas bstan pa// mngon shes lnga thob mi bdag kye// bar ma dbyugs dbyung mchog yin te// bshang lci dang ni zla nyi'o// rtsa bzhi dang ni yan lag ldan// ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin dbugs// 'byung ba lnga'i ngo bo nyid// sangs rgyas lnga'i byin gyis brlabs// srog dang rtsol ba zhes byar bshad// bdag tu 'dzin pa'i stobs kyis ni// rdo rje sems dpa' yang dag 'jug

/lte bar gtum mo spar ba yis// de bzhin gshegs pa lnga sregs te// spyan la sogs pa yang bsregs nas// haṃ bsregs pa las zla rgyun 'bab// dam tshig sems dpa'i spyod yul can// sku mthong nas ni nyin re yis// dus su srog gi rlung rnams yin// rnal 'byor thar pa 'dod pa yis// bum pa'i sbyor bas dgang bar bya// ci srid du ni 'khor bzhin ma// rang gi lus la yongs bskor ba// 'od zer 'khor lo mthong 'gyur te// sngon song sku la rang gi yin// de ni zla drug reg yang bde// chu nyi lta bu rab snang ba// dri ma med pa sna tshogs mdog /rnam pa kun tu rang gi sems// rang gi sems nyid bde ba nyid// ting 'dzin bde chen rnal 'byor la// spyan lnga mngon shes drug 'byung ste// chu srin la sogs khyim rnams su// ma rig la sogs lugs bzlog pas// sa ni bcu gnyis thob 'gyur te// rtog pa med pa'i chos can la// skad cig gcig la mngon sangs rgyas// rdo rje nyi ma snang ba che// rdo rje zla ba dri med 'od// sa rnams yongs su rdzogs pa yi// dngos po gnyis su rab bstan te// ye shes yod pa de na de// skyob pa ye shes can du brjod// dmigs pa med pa'i snying rje yis// sgyu 'phrul dra bas byang chub pas// yid bzhin nor bu lta bur ni// mtha' yas sems can re ba bskong*// sems can bsgrol ba'i bde ba che// 'dzag pa'i 'dod chags sel bar byed// 'gro drug sdug bsngal sel byed pa// lam mchog tshol dang phrad par shog /sbyor ba gsum gyi snying po gsal ba zhes bya ba/ byang chub sems dpa' 'jam dpal rgyal po grags par gdul bya la dgongs nas/ skye ba bzhes nas mdzad pa rdzogs so// paṇḍi ta so ma na tha dang*/ lo tstsa ba 'brog shes rab grags kyis sbyar ba'o// zhus so dge'o/// /
